description: Eight stereo mute gates that silence a random set of their channel pairs, choosing a new set each time a trigger arrives.

params.text: Sets how many of the patched channels are silenced, in whole steps from 0 to 8; the maker's tooltip calls it the number of channels left unmuted, which is the reverse of what the module does.

inputs.text: A rising edge picks a fresh random set of stereo channels to silence.
Adds to the MUTE knob, -5V adding no channels, 0V adding four and +5V adding eight, rounded to a whole number; the total is not held inside the 0 to 8 the knob covers.
The left signal of that stereo channel.
The right signal of that stereo channel.

outputs.text: The left signal of that channel passed through, or 0V while the channel is silenced.
The right signal of that channel passed through, or 0V while the channel is silenced.

notes: Every channel passes until the first trigger reaches TRIG; the set of silenced channels is only redrawn on a trigger.
A stereo channel counts as patched when either side has both its input and its output connected, and silencing then applies to both sides together.
The green lamp beside a channel is lit while that channel is passing and dark while it is silenced.
Only the first channel of a polyphonic cable is passed.

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
